# Spell list

To cast: press C (Cast), pick the character's number, choose W or C if that character knows both kinds of magic, then press the spell's letter.

A spell's letter is also its rank. Rank A costs 0 magic points, and every rank after that costs 5 more (B costs 5, C costs 10 ... P costs 75). A character can never cast a spell that costs more than their maximum magic points.

Effects below are summarized from the original spellbooks. Open "Wizard spellbook" or "Cleric spellbook" on the Book tab to read the full pages.

# Wizard spells

## A. Repond - 0 MP
Dispels orcs, goblins and trolls.

## B. Mittar - 5 MP
A magic missile that strikes one foe.

## C. Lorum - 10 MP
A short-lived magical light.

## D. Dor Acron - 15 MP
Takes the party down one dungeon level.

## E. Sur Acron - 20 MP
Takes the party up one dungeon level.

## F. Fulgar - 25 MP
A fireball hurled at one foe.

## G. Mag Acron - 30 MP
Teleports the party to a random spot on the surface of Sosaria. Works only on the surface.

## H. Mentar - 35 MP
A psychic blow at one foe. Damage grows with the caster's intelligence.

## I. Dag Lorum - 40 MP
A long-lasting light.

## J. Fal Divi - 45 MP
Lets a wizard cast any cleric spell. It often fails.

## K. Noxum - 50 MP
Strikes every foe in the battle.

## L. Decorp - 55 MP
Kills one foe.

## M. Altair - 60 MP
Stops time, freezing the world while the party moves freely.

## N. Dag Mentar - 65 MP
A powerful blow against every foe. Damage grows with the caster's intelligence.

## O. Necorp - 70 MP
Leaves every foe with little strength left for battle.

## P. (no name) - 75 MP
Destroys all foes who hear it.

# Cleric spells

## A. Pontori - 0 MP
Dispels undead: skeletons, ghouls and zombies.

## B. Appar Unem - 5 MP
Disarms a trapped chest.

## C. Sanctu - 10 MP
Heals minor wounds. Grows stronger with experience.

## D. Luminae - 15 MP
A short-lived light.

## E. Rec Su - 20 MP
Takes the party up one dungeon level.

## F. Rec Du - 25 MP
Takes the party down one dungeon level.

## G. Lib Rec - 30 MP
Moves the party to another place within the dungeon. Must be cast in a dungeon.

## H. Alcort - 35 MP
Cures poison.

## I. Sequitu - 40 MP
Lifts the party out of a dungeon to the surface.

## J. Sominae - 45 MP
A long-lasting light.

## K. Sanctu Mani - 50 MP
Major healing for one near death.

## L. Vieda - 55 MP
Shows a vision of the surroundings, in a dungeon or on the surface.

## M. Excuun - 60 MP
Kills one foe.

## N. Surmandum - 65 MP
Brings a dead companion back to life. If it fails, the body turns to ashes.

## O. Zxkuqyb - 70 MP
Strikes down most foes in the battle.

## P. Anju Sermani - 75 MP
Restores a companion who has turned to ashes. The caster permanently gives up 5 points of wisdom.
